issues.issue: Statement of Activities p2-3 shows 494,445 of this as capital grants and contributions (Airport 343,180 under public works, 151,265 environment and leisure) and 1,500 operating grants; the airport money is likely a government (FAA/state) grant. donations/contributions is defensible under the mixed-label ruling but may understate grants. Same applies to detail Airport 'Contributions and grants' 343,180 (p14) and the General Fund department lines.

Transportation is an object-of-expenditure line inside an itemized department, not a function total; 'not itemized' does not fit (training and travel / fuel would). Same for Park Transportation 4,562 (detail[53]). 'Transportation' is a context label in category_decisions.

Capital outlay lines should be labelled 'Capital Outlay: <function>'; this Zoning line and the CDA (p13, 224,228), Airport (p14, 820,228), Debt Service (p15, 306,808) and Capital Projects (p16, 77,685) capital outlay lines keep the bare label, while the other departments' lines carry a function.
